name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Channel & Partner Marketing Specialist | B2B SaaS Growth, ROI Reporting & Partner Enablement
summary: Marketing operator with 15+ years in B2B SaaS and agency environments, including direct channel-partner experience managing a nationally distributed network of 15-20 reseller partners at ~94% retention and building the ROI/CAC/LTV reporting frameworks that turn campaign activity into a clear growth story. Comfortable translating a partner's or client's business objectives into a scalable marketing plan, then executing it hands-on, from demand-generation systems to cross-functional coordination with Sales and Product. Works daily in Slack, ClickUp, and Google Workspace across remote, distributed teams.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect and deploy full-lifecycle demand-generation systems - lead capture, routing, qualification, nurture, and reactivation - for a portfolio of B2B service clients, translating each client's business goals into a scalable, measurable campaign plan.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights that drive experimentation and program adjustments.
Track acquisition and performance in GA4 and Google Search Console across multiple concurrent accounts, reporting findings to stakeholders on a regular cadence.
Draft direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages that drive engagement and pipeline for client campaigns.

experience.title: Channel Marketing & Client Strategy — Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, translating results into optimization recommendations and QBRs for client leadership.
Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content, coordinating execution across internal departments on multi-stakeholder accounts.

experience.title: Channel Partner Marketing — Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners nationally (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail), retaining all but one (~94% retention), driving adoption of marketing automation and reputation-management solutions across the network.

Sold and onboarded partners onto Birdeye's proprietary data-aggregator/listings-syndication solution, the backbone of the channel offer, and developed scalable communication workflows and automated training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer-health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value directly to their own end customers.

Collaborated cross-functionally with Product and Engineering, translating structured partner feedback into roadmap input - the same cross-team coordination a partner marketing program requires with Sales and Product.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years, a team of 20, later a team of 8, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
